claim.quote: We set a new upper limits to the neutrino mixing matrix element U^2_{e4} which improve existing limits by a factor from 2 to 5 in the mass range 0.1-2 keV.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published JETP Letters 105, 753 (2017).

key_value_text.quote: We set a new upper limits to the neutrino mixing matrix element U^2_{e4} which improve existing limits by a factor from 2 to 5 in the mass range 0.1-2 keV.
key_value_text.value: Limits on the mixing |Ue4|² of a heavy sterile neutrino, improving earlier limits by a factor of 2 to 5 for masses of 0.1-2 keV

name: First measurements in search for keV sterile neutrino in tritium beta-decay in the Troitsk nu-mass experiment

summary.plain: The Troitsk tritium setup looked for a kink in the electron spectrum that a heavy (keV) sterile neutrino would cause. It saw none, and set limits on how strongly such a neutrino could mix with the electron neutrino, two to five times tighter than before.
summary.technical: First measurement of the tritium beta spectrum over 16-18.6 keV electron energy; upper limits on |Ue4|² for sterile-neutrino masses 0.1-2 keV, a factor 2-5 better than previous limits.

title: First measurements in search for keV sterile neutrino in tritium beta-decay in the Troitsk nu-mass experiment
why_it_matters: Shows the tritium-endpoint technique can search for keV sterile neutrinos, a dark-matter candidate, and motivates the TRISTAN detector upgrade of KATRIN.
